correctness.rationale: The graph uses precisely the XOR steps 1,2,4,8,15, and tracking induced degrees gives the component-size-two face family. Independent enumeration gave 2,143 augmented faces and the facet split of sixteen size-five and ten size-eight facets. The pair (empty,{0}) is the only augmented pair removed; the other 1,065 pairs agree with the ordinary matching since every edge containing 0 is paired at the first pivot, so {0} cannot be matched later. All 2,142 ordinary faces were sorted through 9,280 directed covers, leaving one 0-cell, five 3-cells and six 4-cells. Signed unit-incidence elimination reproduces the stated 5-by-6 matrix with leading determinant −1. The first five 4-cells together with the 3-skeleton form a simply connected integrally acyclic CW subcomplex, hence contractible; the sixth attaches nullhomotopically to it, giving S⁴. The ten pair sums of the directions are identified by their pairs of common neighbors with 0, bounding the stabilizer by S5. Translations and linear direction permutations realize the full group. Signed trace replay agreed with sign of the direction permutation on all 1,920 affine actions, so the integral rank-one H4 has precisely that action.
residual_risks: Only the stated graph and cutoff are verified. No equivariant homotopy model is inferred. Frozen code was inspected, not executed.
